label: CZone Control
info:
CZone digital switching via Victron Virtual Switches. v7.1 — no Signal-K, no bank 10.
Bidirectional via can0:
  • State    (CZone → VRM): candump PGN 127501 bank instance 1 (CZone Output Interface)
  • Commands (VRM → CZone): cansend PGN 127502 bank instance 1, as the Simrad MFD does
Circuit semantics decide the frame (the sender is irrelevant):
  • LATCHING (4-11, lights): 01 = press, TOGGLES the latch; 00 = release, ignored.
    Sent as press + release 120ms later, and only when a FRESH 127501 reading
    disagrees with the target — a toggle on stale state could flip the wrong way.
  • MOMENTARY (1-3, bilge pumps + horn): output FOLLOWS the bit. 01 = on, 00 = off.
    Level control, never a press/release pair — v7.0 sent one and the release
    switched the horn straight back off, which then echoed round and oscillated.
Only bank 1 is used. A configuration may define further banks over the same outputs
with different switch types, but the outputs OR together: a secondary bank can force an
output on, yet its OFF cannot clear a latch set on bank 1 at a keypad/MFD. Bank 1 is the
user latch everything else shares.
Echo defenses: 12s deploy guard, fresh-state dedupe, and a per-switch/per-value echo
map recording every write we push into a virtual switch (the palette strips
_czoneSync, so our own writes return looking like user clicks).
Retry: only on evidence a send was lost (a 127501 reading after it that still
disagrees) + 2.5s floor for send latency; one retry, then revert after 9s.
Decoder ignores 127501 with bank instance ≠ 1 — the Navico autopilot (src 0x0C)
spams instance 0 "all OFF" at 5Hz; ingesting it strobed the lights (v6.0).

name: ═══ CAN STATE MONITOR (candump 127501) → VIRTUAL SWITCH SYNC ═══
info:
candump can0,01F20D00:03FFFF00 captures PGN 127501 from any source/priority.
Watchdog pattern from Virtual BMS: pkill stale capture before start, chunk-safe
line parser, restart 5s after candump exits.
Decoder trusts ONLY bank instance 1 (the CZone Output Interface). Device 0x0C
broadcasts instance 0 all-OFF at 5Hz and must be ignored.

info: NOTE: the CZone UC1 NAKs every ISO Request, including this one for 127501 (ISO Acknowledgement ctrl=1). It answers only 60928 and 126996. This inject is therefore a no-op and is kept only as documentation — state recovers on its own because the UC1 broadcasts 127501 every 2s regardless.

name: Show All States
═══ VIRTUAL SWITCHES (VRM UI) ═══
info:
Input sets state from CZone. Output 2 sends commands to CZone.
NOTE: the victron-virtual-switch node does NOT preserve message properties from input
to output — a state write echoes out the command side without _czoneSync, looking
exactly like a user click. The engine's czEcho map (per switch, per value) is what
recognises and drops those; the deploy guard and fresh-state dedupe back it up.
Switch types mirror the CZone circuit config: sw1/sw2 bilge and sw3 horn are
momentary, sw4-sw11 lights are latching.

═══ CONTROL ENGINE + CONFIRM / RETRY ═══
info:
Control Engine turns {switch, action} into a PGN 127502 bank-1 press + release pair and
registers it pending. It presses only when a fresh 127501 reading disagrees with the
target — a press toggles, so state must be trustworthy.
Confirm & Retry engine (250ms tick):
  • confirms pending commands against 127501 state newer than the command
  • re-presses only on evidence the last press was lost: a reading taken after it
    that still disagrees, and at least 1.5s elapsed (so send latency cannot fake it)
  • max 3 presses, then reverts the virtual switch after 8s
No keep-alive and no holds: CZone latches a bank-1 press natively, so a redeploy no
longer drops VRM-lit circuits.
